package: @astryxdesign/cli

## Generate a palette

Name a few seed colors and generate every shade a theme needs, light and dark; `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs authoring/building-blocks/themes/generate-a-palette` explains what a palette holds.

Minimal palette config (palette.config.json):
```json
{"families": [{"id": "ocean", "seed": "#0074e2"}]}
```

Generate and preview:
```bash
# Print the palette without writing files
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate palette.config.json

# Write palette + receipt, and open a visual preview
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme palette generate palette.config.json \
  --out src/themes/ocean/tokens/ocean.palette.ts \
  --preview preview.html
```

The command writes a `.ts` file exporting 21 shades (stops 0–100) for both light and dark, plus a `.receipt.json` to regenerate later. Point your theme's tokens at the palette, then run defineTheme (see below).

For the full palette config fields and CLI flags, run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-palette-generate`. For the integration-authoring walkthrough of connecting a palette to theme tokens, run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs authoring/building-blocks/themes/generate-a-palette`.
